response.sql:
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS average_aCL_IgM
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN e.`ANA Pattern` = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
ORDER BY average_aCL_IgM IS NULL ASC, average_aCL_IgM DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A patient qualifies only if none of their examinations has ANA Pattern = 'S'; all examinations for qualifying patients contribute to the average, with AVG ignoring null values.
